goal: Decide whether a tightly scoped Configuration Package write gate is justified after read-first proof of Configuration Worksheet and Configuration Packages.
whyNow: FOUNDATION-CONFIGURATION-WORKSHEET-READFIRST proved the relevant setup-data surfaces read-only, but package create, get-tables, import, export, validate, apply and setup writes remain locked until their business purpose, fields, evidence plan and keep/cleanup strategy are explicitly decided.
expectedOutput: A local decision result JSON that chooses ready-for-narrow-write-gate, parked or rejected.
If ready, a next case that permits only one explicitly named package metadata action with screenshots, stop rules and keep/cleanup proof.
If not ready, a parked/alternative route with no live execution.
stopConditions: Stop if the decision needs fresh Business Central evidence.
Stop if field mapping is not source-backed.
Stop if the proposed write would create broad package metadata instead of one narrow auditable artifact.
Stop if cleanup/keep/reopen proof cannot be stated before the write.
Stop if the step would jump to master data, documents, preview, posting or API.

nextCaseOptions.when: Use only if one narrow package metadata action is justified, reversible or keep-worthy, and screenshot/reopen proof is defined.
Use if package write risk is not justified yet.
